G07 half-value: ALL 24 Witcher 3 interval-run frames are sun-up exteriors. exterior_lowlight gets ZERO interval-run frames from them and still has none.

THE BINDING CONSTRAINT IS NOW block_score, NOT COVERAGE. 199 files carry heavily_recompressed:true from COMPUTED block_score > 1.15 — 19 of 22 in interior_darkemissive, 16 of 24 in exterior_lowlight. Steam re-encodes user screenshot uploads and Steam is the only source with the needed breadth. More Steam frames will not fix these two profiles; a different KIND of source will (lossless capture series, press kit, Digital Foundry frame dump).

PROVENANCE STRUCTURE DEFECT (root cause of H2/H3): 68 records were keyed by bare id (REF-A1..A19 slot ids, run-w3nextgen-*, REF-ER-*) while make-manifest.py joins BY PATH, so 140 files produced PROVENANCE_MISSING regardless of how well their provenance was written. Fixed by copying each id-keyed record down to its path key with provenance_inherited_from; id-keyed records retained.
H5 closed: the 3 corroboration:'unknown' files moved to rejected/ per §8b.

STEAM publishedfileid is monotonic in time — 97 directly-read page dates, 0 violations, Feb 2014 to Mar 2024. sid < ~2,900,000,000 == pre-2023. Used as the primary triage filter and as a bracket-inference route for §8b (95 direct + 145 bracketed + 36 unresolved).
STEAM /sharedfiles/filedetails/ 429s after ~19 burst requests, is still throttled at 1 req/4s, sustains at 1 req/14s. ISteamRemoteStorage/GetPublishedFileDetails returns result:9 for screenshots.
STEAM listing card: id is in data-publishedfileid="N", page URL in data-modal-content-url, NOT a plain href before the img. A href-then-img regex returns zero rows.

MORROWIND VANILLA: ~4 in 5 top-rated Morrowind screenshots at >=1920 wide FAIL V2 (MGE XE / OpenMW distant land). Filtering to <=1366 native width recovers a genuinely vanilla population (234 of 576). The vanilla fog wall closing the middle distance is the discriminator.

searchText=bloodstain on app 374320 is the query that answers RI-JRN06 — it returns real bloodstain pools at distance. It was in NEITHER candidate pool. searchText='you died' returns images TITLED that, almost never the card.

YOUTUBE IS CLOSED to this container: yt-dlp search works, every download returns 'Sign in to confirm you're not a bot' (web/web_safari/android_vr/ios) or 'DRM protected' (tv); mweb lists only storyboards. V1-dolly and V2-static could not be filled.
archive.org IS OPEN: PC_Longplay_Dark_Souls_Remastered.ia.mp4 = 3.3GB / 9h11m / 854x480 h.264 derivative (used). The RDR2 100% longplay is 82GB with NO derivative.

Steam ESO app 306130 listing returned ZERO cards for every query today, including ones the prior critic used successfully. Only the 30 pre-harvested candidates were usable; no explicit xanmeer ziggurat frame among them.
